name: Finals bout
win: the opponent is knocked out or yields
lose: you are knocked out or yield (judging still counts how you fought)

phases.name: Pride
phases.behaviour: aggressive fire jutsu at mid range and a fast chain close; dodges 30%
phases.openings: interrupt the signs: it weaves at 4 blocks

phases.name: Pressure
phases.behaviour: shuriken with fire (phoenix flowers with hidden steel) and a clone feint
phases.openings: sensing or parry the real one

phases.name: No holding back
phases.behaviour: its signature on a 20-tick tell; if it has the Sharingan, telegraphs are shorter against it
phases.openings: water or a wall; then a finisher

notes: Role-based: the rival in Classic; in Varied the finals opponent is whoever the bracket gives (role:rival by default)
